'''Skiffer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. He was part of a group that came into conflict with the "[[Walkway Collective]]," the survivors near the [[Catier Walkway]], led by [[Tenga Javik]].

Skiffer and his entire group were killed by [[Irek Ismaren|Lord Nyax]]. At the time, Nyax was pursuing [[Yassat]], a scout for the Walkway Collective, but Yassat intentionally led the pursuing monster in Skiffer's direction as a distraction. The last thing Yassat heard of the group was Skiffer's call to action and his dying screams.
